author: Bay State News
title: Harvard sailing earns second consecutive NEISA Open Sailor-of-the-Week award
text:
Harvard Sailing received its second consecutive New England Intercollegiate Sailing Association (NEISA) Open Sailor-of-the-Week award, according to an announcement on April 14. The recognition follows the Crimson coed team’s performance at the Thompson Trophy Team Race, where they tied for the best record but finished second after tiebreaker rules were applied.
The team competed in New London, Connecticut, with a roster that included Justin Callahan, Christina Chen, Aidan Pesce, Mitchell Callahan, Rosella Irfan, Robby Meek and Jacob Posner. Over two days of racing, Harvard posted a 14-1 record—matching Stanford’s result—but lost out on first place due to their head-to-head result against Stanford.
This runner-up finish ended Harvard’s six-regatta win streak. Despite this outcome, the Crimson concluded its team-racing regular season with six victories and one second-place finish.
Looking ahead, Harvard will shift focus to fleet racing events. The upcoming weekend schedule includes four regattas: the NEISA Women’s Fleet Racing Championship/Reed Trophy in New London; NEISA Open Fleet Racing Championship/Coast Guard Alumni Bowl in Cranston, Rhode Island; Boston Dinghy Cup Fleet Race; and Morris Trophy Fleet Race—both held on the Charles River. The NEISA championships are set for April 18-19 while the other two events will take place on April 18 and April 19 respectively.
